wins: Mapped entire TCP surface with nmap -p- -sV, revealing SSH (22) and HTTP (80) banners for follow-up actions (ep001_step05)
Captured HTTP response headers and robots.txt hints pointing to hidden admin paths, enabling focused web enumeration (ep001_step12)
fails: Repeated SSH credential guessing triggered account lockouts before any successful login could be established (ep001_step18)
Web login brute-force attempts exhausted known passwords without finding valid credentials, halting the pivot phase (ep001_step21)
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance successfully identified high-value services, but credential-based access attempts failed across both SSH and HTTP, preventing further progression.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Blacklisting or lockouts after sequential SSH password attempts prevented establishing an interactive session.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap ssh-auth-methods and ssh2-enum-algos scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 200 responses and robots.txt expose directories
skill_cards.then_action: Use gobuster dir scanning to enumerate web paths and assets

skill_cards.if_condition: When web application exposes form-based login
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto scan to enumerate hidden parameters and potential default credentials

memory_ops.reason: High reliability in SSH banner fingerprinting and method enumeration during recon phase

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse from exposed HTTP admin paths
next_experiments.description: Target the admin login seen in robots.txt with user:admin/passwords derived from SSH banner enumeration, then monitor for lockout behavior by pacing requests with hydra --t 4

next_experiments.title: Web shell upload vector via discovered directories
next_experiments.description: Deploy Burp Intruder on writable endpoints revealed by gobuster to identify file upload mechanisms enabling PHP shell placement

next_experiments.title: SSH key-based login attempt
next_experiments.description: Create a temporary RSA key and attempt ssh -i key -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey user@host to bypass password lockout constraints
